editorial:
Imagine waking up to find your entire life was built on a lie and your reputation is completely ruined. You get to step into the shoes of a man who lost everything after a huge financial crash and now spends his days hiding away from the world. The vibe here is very heavy and serious, focusing on a guy who can't let go of his past mistakes. You will feel the tension as he deals with family drama and the feeling that he can never truly fix what he broke. It is a slow burn that focuses more on talking and feelings than big action scenes, making it feel like a stage play brought to the screen.

What really works here is the acting, as you can see the pain and regret on the characters' faces in every scene. The pacing is a bit slow, so you need to be in the right mood for a heavy drama. If you love stories about fallen giants and family secrets, you should definitely give this one a try. It is a great pick for a quiet rainy night when you want something that makes you think about life.
endingExplained: In the end, you see the main character realize that his dreams of regaining his power are impossible. He finally accepts that he cannot change the past or bring back his old status. The story wraps up with a sad sense of peace as he stops fighting against his reality. He lets go of his pride and accepts his failure, leaving you with a bittersweet feeling as the screen fades to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves deep character studies and old school dramas.
